sql_catalog.title: Revenue Exposure by Contract Type
sql_catalog.description: Calculates leaked MRR, active MRR, and churn rates across contract types.
sql_catalog.sql: SELECT contract_type, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(AVG(churn_status)*100, 1) AS churn_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN churn_status = 1 THEN monthly_charges ELSE 0 END), 2) AS leaked_mrr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN churn_status = 0 THEN monthly_charges ELSE 0 END), 2) AS active_mrr FROM customers GROUP BY contract_type ORDER BY leaked_mrr DESC;

sql_catalog.title: High-Risk Customer Triage (Top 10 Accounts by MRR)
sql_catalog.description: Filters active accounts in High Risk band and ranks by monthly billing.
sql_catalog.sql: SELECT customer_id, company_name, subscription_tier, contract_type, monthly_charges, churn_risk_score, days_since_last_login, support_tickets_30d FROM customers WHERE churn_status = 0 AND risk_tier = 'High Risk' ORDER BY monthly_charges DESC LIMIT 10;

sql_catalog.title: Support Ticket Friction Correlation
sql_catalog.description: Examines churn rates grouped by support ticket volume in the past 30 days.
sql_catalog.sql: SELECT support_tickets_30d AS tickets, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(AVG(churn_status)*100, 1) AS churn_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(nps_score), 1) AS avg_nps FROM customers GROUP BY support_tickets_30d ORDER BY tickets ASC;

sql_catalog.title: Industry Churn & Feature Adoption Profile
sql_catalog.description: Benchmarks feature adoption scores against churn rates across industries.
sql_catalog.sql: SELECT industry, COUNT(*) AS accounts, ROUND(AVG(churn_status)*100, 1) AS churn_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(feature_adoption_rate), 1) AS avg_adoption_rate, ROUND(AVG(total_charges), 2) AS avg_lifetime_revenue FROM customers GROUP BY industry ORDER BY churn_rate_pct DESC;
